provenance.disclaimer: Illustrative listener features and parameters. No Spotify user data or internal configuration.
provenance.shap: Exact native XGBoost TreeSHAP, raw log-odds, tree-path-dependent background.
provenance.evaluation: F1 and AUC measure held-out surrogate fidelity to discovered labels, not cluster validity.
provenance.recursion: Child UMAP fits use the same original six features and the global scaler. Maximum depth: one recursive fit.
